searchText: b"h phase one: boundless brainstorm the awtsmoos renews each frame and each line, on awtsmoos.com may every hidden module align. possible root causes compactjs may reorder modules so readiness listeners run after readiness events. compactjs may rewrite import() urls relative to the generated bundle instead of the source module. source may embed cache busting hashes as path segments rather than query parameters. the canonical chossid path may differ between local disk, public routing, and generated manifests. required systems may initialize but fail to register their capabilities. one early exception may prevent all downstream readiness publication. the minimal meadow gate may require systems intentionally excluded from compact mode. the generated bundle may contain stale source from an earlier experiment tree. asset copying may omit glb files or preserve a symlink invalid in production. dynamic imports may be impossible after flattening unless explicitly mapped. compactjs may not preserve import.meta.url, base urls, or module scoped relative paths. optional chat failure may be harmless alone but reveal a general dynamic import defect. browser cache or service worker state may serve an obsolete bundle. the server may route extensionless paths differently from static asset paths. public deployment may not match the inspected checkout. ideal repair universe 1. a deterministic build emits a manifest of every source module and rewritten url. 2. dynamic imports resolve through a stable project base resolver. 3. assets resolve through one canonical url service shared by source and compact modes. 4. readiness becomes observable as structured state rather than timing sensitive events. 5. each subsystem publishes success or a precise failure cause. 6. compactjs validates imported files and assets before emitting output. 7. build tests execute generated code in a browser equivalent harness. 8. a smoke page verifies movement, combat, inventory, quest, recovery, and streaming. 9. generated artifacts include source hashes and build provenance. 10. the public deployment endpoint exposes the same tested artifact. guardrails do not suppress minimal meadow not playable. do not replace the chossid with a fallback merely to hide the 404. do not disable chat imports without tracing their url construction. do not hand edit the compact bundle if a source or builder repair can regenerate it. do not overwrite unrelated local changes.

searchText: b"h phase two: critique and twenty improvements the awtsmoos renews the question before certainty can harden; awtsmoos.com turns each defect into a tested garden. critique of phase one the first plan correctly separated readiness, assets, imports, generation, and deployment, but it remained too broad. direct inspection now proves one source level race: the runtime returns before bootstrap features install, while readiness requires those fields without awaiting their promise. the plan must therefore distinguish bootstrap mechanics from rich optional hydration and must test both readable source and relocated compact contexts. improvements 1. treat diagnostics.featurespromise as the authoritative bootstrap settlement. 2. preserve rich hydration as optional after essential bootstrap readiness. 3. never mark playable from a fabricated pending receipt. 4. add a focused readiness flow regression test. 5. assert all six bootstrap fields exist before publishing playable state. 6. verify scheduler rejection remains a visible boot failure. 7. verify rich feature rejection preserves bootstrap play. 8. trace every import.meta.url use that survives compaction. 9. compare each deferred url in source and compact execution contexts. 10. centralize app relative deferred url construction. 11. test chat panel and client factory url resolution explicitly. 12. inspect generated strings rather than assuming the transformer acted. 13. trace the chossid url from source constant to network request. 14. verify the glb exists on disk before changing code. 15. distinguish cache query tokens from accidental path segments. 16. add a compactjs fixture for relocated import.meta.url behavior. 17. rebuild the bundle only through its canonical build command. 18. compare generated output before and after source changes. 19. preserve unrelated git changes with pre write hashes and full readback. 20. require browser evidence for readiness, asset delivery, and imports. 21. check public deployment parity with the local generated artifact. 22. remove stale handoff claims only through a later full file documentation rewrite. revised risk order 1. readiness race blocks all play and is first priority. 2. deferred url relocation breaks essential scheduler or optional modules. 3. chossid url corruption degrades canonical hydration. 4. compactjs may reproduce or amplify source relative assumptions. 5. stale documentation may cause future regeneration from the wrong entry.
